events.text: At the top of everything there is no wind, no sky, no floor: only the Dao, and you. Then the Dao opens like a door, and out of it, one by one, come the lives you have lived. They do not look like you. They all look at you the same way, the way one looks at the last page of a long book.

effects.log: You wait. The first of them steps forward.
"I know you," you say, and you do. The first of them smiles and steps forward.

events.text: {pst_Name} steps out of the Dao: {pst_what}. They walk around you once, slowly, looking at what their life became when it went on without them. "So this is where it was going," {pst_name} says. "I always wondered."

effects.log: You hold out your hand and ask.
You take them as they were, mistakes and all, and they come into you without a word.

choices.text: Thank them, and let them go

effects.log: You thank them for the road. They go back into the Dao lighter.

events.text: {pst_Name} steps out of the Dao: {pst_what}. They remember another peak, another life of yours that stood here and said no. "You refused us once," {pst_name} says. "We have been wondering whether you meant it."

choices.text: Ask them, again, to join you

effects.log: You ask, and this time you mean it.
You do not ask. You simply take them back, and they let you.

choices.text: Tell them you meant it, and let them go

effects.log: You meant it. They nod, as if you have confirmed something, and go.

events.text: Out of the Dao comes {pst_name}, {pst_what}, enormous and patient, smelling of rain on stone. It lowers its great head until its eye is level with yours. It does not speak. It never did. It only waits to see if you remember it.

choices.text: Lay a hand on its brow and ask

effects.log: You lay your hand on its brow, and ask without words.
You put your arms around as much of it as you can reach. It makes the sound it made when it was happy.

choices.text: Bow to it, and let it go

effects.log: You bow to it. It turns, slow as a mountain, and walks back into the Dao.

events.text: {pst_Name} steps out of the Dao in the robes of {pst_what}, and for a moment every god in the Divine Realm seems to stand a little straighter. "I ruled a world," the Emperor says. "You rule only yourself. Convince me that is more."

effects.log: You argue it, as one sovereign to another.

choices.text: Kneel and take the Emperor back

effects.log: You kneel. The Emperor raises you up, and the robes settle on your shoulders and vanish.

choices.text: Tell the Emperor the throne is over, and let them go

effects.log: The Emperor looks at you a long time, and then laughs, and goes.

events.text: The last to step out of the Dao is {pst_name}: {pst_what}. They are smiling. "Everyone else came to judge you," they say. "I came to see if you are finally honest enough to admit you are me."

choices.text: Ask them to join you on your terms

effects.log: You ask, on your terms, and wait for the answer.
You take them back, dark and all. It is heavier than you thought, and it is yours.

choices.text: Refuse to carry them, and let them go

effects.log: You let them go. They shrug, still smiling, and go back into the Dao.

events.text: Your past selves stand around you at the top of everything, the ones who joined you close, the others further off. They are waiting. Take them all back into one self and be done, take only some, or thank them and stay who you are: the answer is yours, and none of them will hurry you.

effects.log: You breathe. There is no hurry at the top of everything.

choices.text: Look at each of them in turn

effects.log: You look at each face, and each one looks back. The answer is coming.

events.text: The past selves who joined you are part of you now: their years, their strength, their old griefs grown quiet. The ones who did not stand a little apart, at the edge of the Dao, and you understand they will remember this. Then they are gone, and it is only you again. Larger.

choices.text: Thank the ones who stayed apart

effects.log: You thank them across the distance. One of them raises a hand.
You walk on. There is still a life to live, even here.

events.text: "I am this one," you said, and the past selves heard it. They do not argue. They each touch your shoulder as they pass, the way travellers touch a milestone, and walk back into the Dao. The last one turns at the edge. "We will remember you said that," they say. It sounds like a blessing.

effects.log: You bow until they are gone. You are only yourself. It is enough.
You laugh, a little, at the top of everything. It is a very human sound up here.

events.text: A dream: a crowd of strangers at the top of a mountain that is not a mountain, each one touching your shoulder as they pass. You wake knowing one thing very clearly, though you could not say how: once, somewhere, you chose to stay yourself, and they let you.

effects.log: Whatever this life becomes, it will be yours. The thought is very steadying.
You wonder all day. By evening the faces are gone, and the feeling is not.

events.text: In a deep meditation above the clouds, strangers file past you on a summit that is not a summit, each touching your shoulder. You come out of it certain of one thing: once, somewhere, you chose to stay yourself, and they let you.

effects.log: Whatever this life becomes, it will be yours. The thought is very steadying.
You wonder all day. By evening the faces are gone, and the feeling is not.

events.text: Some mornings you know things you never learned: how a beast sleeps, how a throne feels, how a certain old song goes. A teacher says you have an old soul. You think, privately, that it is several, and that some of them are still waiting for you.

choices.text: Listen for the ones who wait

effects.log: You listen. Very far off, someone is still standing at the edge of the Dao.

choices.text: Be grateful for the ones who came

effects.log: You are grateful. The song goes on in your head all day.

events.text: Some years above the clouds you wake knowing things no one here taught you: how a beast sleeps, how a throne sits, how an old song of the world below goes. An old immortal says you have an old soul. You suspect you have several.

choices.text: Listen for the ones who wait

effects.log: You listen. Very far off, someone is still standing at the edge of the Dao.

choices.text: Be grateful for the ones who came

effects.log: You are grateful. The song goes on in your head all day.

events.text: An old monk stops you in the street and stares. "You," he says, "are very crowded." Before you can ask what he means he laughs, bows, and goes. All day you feel as if a great many people are walking behind you, kindly.

choices.text: Bow to the crowd behind you

effects.log: You bow to nobody. It feels like bowing to everybody.
You walk on. However many you are, you are walking the same way.

events.text: An immortal you have never met stops you on a cloud road and stares. "You," the immortal says, "are very crowded." Then a laugh, a bow, and gone. All day you feel a great many people walking behind you on the clouds, kindly.

choices.text: Bow to the crowd behind you

effects.log: You bow to nobody. It feels like bowing to everybody.
You walk on. However many you are, you are walking the same way.
